AI system has not generated any learning cycles, opportunities, or adjustments, which may suggest it is not functioning as intended.

Review and potentially recalibrate AI models to ensure they are actively learning and generating opportunities.
Evaluate the effectiveness of active trading strategies and adjust parameters or switch strategies if necessary.
